context: Derive the Role type from the ROLES array with `as const` instead of maintaining a separate `string` alias.
explanation: as const makes ROLES a readonly tuple of literals, and Role is derived from it with (typeof ROLES)[number], so the two can never drift out of sync. Passing an invalid role like "superadmin" is now a compile-time error instead of a silently accepted string, which is why that bad call had to be deleted.
